title: Chickpea Casserole Italiano
description: A hearty, comforting casserole with chickpeas, Italian flavors, and a gooey cheese topping. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the Italian seasoning, crushed tomatoes, and chickpeas.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, and mozzarella cheese.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared casserole dish.
Top with additional mozzarella cheese, if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
